title: Lifting a homology quotient through an epimorphic subobject presentation
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let $T,E,H,F$ be objects. Let $B\subseteq Z\subseteq T$ be subobjects and $\pi:Z\twoheadrightarrow E$ an epimorphism whose kernel inside $Z$ is the inclusion of $B$. For morphisms $b:H\to E$ and $d:E\to F$ with $b\,d=0$, put $Z^{\prime}=\pi^{-1}(\ker d)$ and $B^{\prime}=\pi^{-1}(\operatorname{im}b)$, regarded as subobjects of $T$ via $Z\hookrightarrow T$. Then $B\subseteq B^{\prime}\subseteq Z^{\prime}\subseteq Z$. There is a morphism $l:Z^{\prime}\to\ker d$ whose composite with the kernel inclusion is the inclusion $Z^{\prime}\hookrightarrow Z$ followed by $\pi$. This equation uniquely determines $l$. Its composite with the cokernel projection of the kernel lift of $b$ is epimorphic and has kernel equal to the inclusion of $B^{\prime}$ in $Z^{\prime}$.

proof.text: Use imageSubobject_le_iff and kernelSubobject_factors to put image(b) below kernel(d). Apply monotonicity of pullback and image pushforward to get B prime below Z prime. Write Z prime as mk(P.arrow followed by Z.arrow) using exists_iso_map and map_obj_eq_mk, giving Z prime below Z.

The old kernel lies below the pullback of image(b): its arrow followed by pi is zero and factors_zero gives the factorization. Push forward this inequality along Z.arrow and use the assumed kernel equality, map_mk and ofLE_arrow to identify the pushed-forward kernel with B.

The representative of Z prime is isomorphic to the pullback subobject P by isoOfEqMk. Compose this isomorphism with pullbackπ and kernelSubobjectIso to define l. The pullback square and ofLE_arrow give its restriction equation. Abelian.epi_fst_of_isLimit makes pullbackπ epi; composing the isomorphisms and cokernel projection stays epi. Cancellation of the kernel inclusion proves uniqueness.

The private pullback_kernel lemma follows in both directions from factors_pullback_obj_iff and kernelSubobject_factors_iff. Exactness of a cokernel sequence, via exact_of_g_is_cokernel and exact_iff_image_eq_kernel, identifies the kernel of the homology projection with the image of kernel.lift d b. Mapping along kernel.ι d gives image(b), since precomposition with factorThruImageSubobject does not change images.

Apply pullback_kernel to l and the cokernel projection. Substitute the preceding image identity and use pullback_comp and pullback_map_self along kernel.ι d. The restriction equation replaces l followed by kernel.ι d with ofLE followed by pi. Pullback_comp and pullback_map_self along Z.arrow identify this with the pullback of B prime along Z prime.arrow. Finally map_mk and ofLE_arrow identify that pullback with mk(ofLE B prime Z prime).

theorem subobjectHomology_step {T E H F : C} (Z B : Subobject T) (hBZ : B ≤ Z)
    (π : (Z : C) ⟶ E) [Epi π]
    (hker : kernelSubobject π = Subobject.mk (Subobject.ofLE B Z hBZ))
    (b : H ⟶ E) (d : E ⟶ F) (w : b ≫ d = 0) :
    let Z' := (Subobject.«exists» Z.arrow).obj
      ((Subobject.pullback π).obj (kernelSubobject d))
    let B' := (Subobject.«exists» Z.arrow).obj
      ((Subobject.pullback π).obj (imageSubobject b))
    ∃ (hZ : Z' ≤ Z) (_hB : B ≤ B') (hBZ' : B' ≤ Z'),
      ∃ l : (Z' : C) ⟶ kernel d,
        l ≫ kernel.ι d = Subobject.ofLE Z' Z hZ ≫ π ∧
        Epi (l ≫ cokernel.π (kernel.lift d b w)) ∧
        kernelSubobject (l ≫ cokernel.π (kernel.lift d b w)) =
          Subobject.mk (Subobject.ofLE B' Z' hBZ')
